name: Shecurity AI Workshop
postCreateCommand:
python -m pip install --upgrade pip && pip install -r requirements.txt && chmod +x .githooks/pre-commit && git config core.hooksPath .githooks && (test -f .env || printf '# Paste your workshop credentials below.
OPENROUTER_API_KEY=put-your-key-here

# CTFd player login used by ctf.py tools.
CTFD_URL=https://shecurity.em0.at
CTFD_CATEGORY=pentesting-with-ai
CTFD_USERNAME=put-your-ctfd-username-here
CTFD_PASSWORD=put-your-ctfd-password-here
' > .env)
